sections.Profile:
"Hi Dolly," produced by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1965, is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine with a distinctive rotating target mechanism called a Roto-Target. Designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker, this machine is a tribute to the Broadway musical Hello, Dolly! which won multiple Tony Awards in 1964.
